title: fix(doctor): defer missing-plugin migrations with a warning instead of blocking

commit.messageHeadline: fix(doctor): defer unavailable plugin migrations with a warning
test(update): pin missing-plugin fixture proxy upstreams
fix(doctor): preserve pending obligations across repair paths
fix(codex): preserve deletions during deferred migrations
test(update): verify expected missing-plugin warnings
fix(doctor): report pending migrations and honor activation policy
fix(doctor): finish deferred config repairs after migration
fix(doctor): settle retained session sources before completing migrat…
fix(doctor): preserve newer pending migration obligations
refactor(doctor): keep repair planning in the legacy config owner
fix(config): fence writes against new plugin migration obligations
fix(doctor): preserve deferred inputs through archive publication
chore(doctor): refresh PR head after push lag
fix(doctor): avoid migrating state for unrelated config writes
chore(doctor): refresh CI after prerequisite repair
fix(config): share deferred migration and plugin metadata reads
style(config): avoid shadowing snapshot scope bindings
chore(ci): refresh doctor migration checks
chore(ci): refresh doctor checks after registry repair
test(plugins): count batched installed-index reads
fix(doctor): retain deferred migrations through async config loading
fix(doctor): preserve closed ACP metadata during migration retries
chore(ci): refresh doctor checks after routing fixes
fix(doctor): preserve canary deferral and canonical ACP state
test(config): reuse SQL observation during async loading
fix(acp): record source provenance before canonical supersession
test(acp): keep legacy migration coverage with ACP runtime
chore: integrate main for doctor migration validation
test(state): preserve historical schema fixtures after ACP addition
